evals.prompt: Using the web-quality-audit skill, review this page and categorize the findings by severity: a login form has no CSP headers configured (Critical-worthy security gap), the hero image is missing width/height attributes, and one blog post has a meta description that's 200 characters long. Produce the categorized findings.
evals.expected_output: Categorizes the missing CSP as Critical (security), the missing image dimensions as a Core Web Vitals/CLS issue at High or Medium, and the oversized meta description as a Low/Medium SEO issue, using the skill's defined severity levels rather than treating all three as equally urgent.

assertions.text: Labels the missing CSP headers as Critical
Distinguishes severity across the three findings rather than treating them identically

evals.prompt: Using the web-quality-audit skill, do a quick audit summary for a marketing site homepage. List which of the four audit categories you'd check and give one example check per category.
evals.expected_output: Names all four categories the skill defines (Performance, Accessibility, SEO, Best Practices) each with at least one concrete example check, not just performance alone.
